integration_decision.name: SEPARATE_TRANSIENT_HANDOFF_STALENESS_FROM_ARCHIVE_CORRUPTION
integration_decision.new_source_checked_finding: Pinned runner.run_once first append/loads observations.jsonl, computes handoff, then independently publishes latest/audit/anata JSON. Pinned storage.append_observations is append-only, and a stale writer's later anata_latest.json replacement does not remove the already appended rowB archive record. Thus a stale final handoff may be recoverable by a subsequent successful refresh; this recovery and its timing are NOT yet demonstrated. Distinguish temporary published-handoff loss from persistent archive/data loss instead of calling all mixed-generation cases permanent.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_contract: Use existing bounded top-level spawn A/APPENDER/B phase-witness design (A paused before anata_latest.json; APPENDER adds PIT rowB with T=1700000000000, effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000; B positively publishes rowB before A release). Check final supported cf-anata-handoff-v1: if rowB disappears after A resumes, classify expected diagnostic RED, not PASS. NEW RECOVERY CHECK: after all children exit and archive locks release, parse observations.jsonl and assert exactly one rowB with original ID/clocks; run sequential C=runner.run_once(network=False,local_dir=same_tmp,as_of_ms=T), assert C loads/scorers 1/1, no errors, final anata_latest.json restores rowB scoring provenance and archive remains exactly one rowB. If archive lost/corrupted or C fails, classify stronger PERSISTENT_DATA_LOSS; if C restores, classify RECOVERABLE_STALE_HANDOFF. This recovery check does NOT turn the preceding RED into PASS. A serialized repair may make APPENDER wait; require positive lock/phase evidence or INCONCLUSIVE, not inferred PASS. Never synchronously append in parent while A is paused; bounded Event/Queue waits, release in finally, finite joins/terminate+join, exitcodes, no network or sleeps.
